notes: for ever is read as rule 19's recast construct relation on olam rather than as an attributive rendering, since the ASV writes a preposition rather than an adjective for the same chukkat olam it renders attributively elsewhere.
be-tokham fuses as among under rule 30 and its suffix takes them separately.
The article on ger is assimilated into the pointed preposition and takes the written the (rule 12), while the article on the following participle takes the relative that (rule 41).
